figures.finding: Income tax is set by the entity: a flat 10% in the Federation (FBiH), 8% in Republika Srpska (RS) and 10% in Brčko District (BD); the personal allowance is BAM 300 a month in FBiH and BAM 6,000 a year in RS and BD.

value.regional: the entity (FBiH, RS, BD) sets the rate

figures.applies: 2026; the entity of residence decides which column applies. The FBiH rate and BAM 3,600 a year (300 a month) allowance are from the FBiH law as the FBiH Ministry of Finance publishes it (amendments to 65/13); RS and BD figures remain PwC's. Deloitte 2026 gives the RS allowance as BAM 12,000 a year and RS self-employment income 10%: the RS figures are in conflict until the RS law is read (see blocker).

sources.said: Porez na dohodak plaća se po stopi od 10%. … ukupan iznos ostvarenog dohotka umanjuje se za osnovni lični odbitak u visini od 3.600,00 KM za porezni period za koji postoji obaveza plaćanja poreza.
The PIT rate in the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina is a flat rate of 10%. RS PIT rates The PIT rate in Republika Srpska is a flat rate of 8%.
The PIT rate in Brčko District is a flat rate of 10%.
Allowances Monthly (BAM) Personal allowance 300
RS personal allowances Allowances Annually (BAM) Personal allowance 6,000
BD personal allowances Allowances Annually (BAM) Personal allowance 6,000

In the RS, the standard personal income tax rate on employment income is 8%, a 10% rate applies to income from self-employment (although certain small entrepreneurs pay a 2% tax on total gross revenue), and a 13% rate applies to other income. … In the RS, there is a personal deduction in the amount of BAM 12,000 per calendar year

figures.finding: In FBiH the employee pays 31% of gross salary (17% pension, 12.5% health, 1.5% unemployment) and the employer 5% (2.5%, 2%, 0.5%); in RS the employee pays 32.8% (18.5% pension, 12% health, 0.6% unemployment, 1.7% child protection) and the employer nothing; in BD health is 12% and pension goes to the chosen entity's fund.

BD.pension: FBiH or RS fund by choice

sources.said: Contribution for pension and invalid insurance 17.0 2.5 Contribution for health insurance 12.5 2.0 Contribution for unemployment insurance 1.5 0.5 The base for calculation of social security contributions is the gross salary.
Contribution for pension and invalid insurance 18.5 Contribution for health insurance 12.0 Contribution for unemployment insurance 0.6 Contribution for child protection 1.7
There are no employer’s social security contributions in Republika Srpska.

figures.finding: The tax year is the calendar year; the annual return is due by 31 March in FBiH and RS, and by 28 February in BD where monthly withholding did not settle the tax.

sources.said: The deadline for submission of the annual tax return is 31 March of the following year.

An annual tax return is not required in the event when the entire PIT due is considered to be calculated and paid through monthly withholdings from income. If this is not the case, annual tax returns have to be submitted by 28 February of the following year.

figures.finding: Tax and contributions are withheld monthly with the salary; RS contributions are withheld by the employer as income payer.

value.employment: monthly withholding with each salary payment

sources.said: In the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina, monthly social security contributions have to be paid along with salary payment
In Republika Srpska, mandatory social security contributions are calculated on gross salary and have to be withheld by the employer, as an income payer.

figures.finding: Payments for entertainment, art or sports performances and royalties to non-residents bear 10% withholding in FBiH (as 'other' income), RS and BD, unless a treaty reduces it. In FBiH the law itself sets 10% on the whole fee of a non-resident artist, performer or writer, with no allowance, as a final tax.
figures.applies: Corporate withholding rules (stated for payments to foreign entities in RS), 2026.

sources.said: Porez na dohodak od samostalne djelatnosti, koji nerezident ostvari povremenim obavljanjem samostalne djelatnosti (umjetnici, sportisti, književnici i dr.), uključujući i djelatnosti vezane za novinarstvo, radio, televiziju, te organizaciju zabavnih priredbi, plaća se po odbitku od ukupne naknade po stopi od 10% bez prava na priznavanje ličnog odbitka iz člana 24. ovog Zakona. Na ovaj način obračunati i plaćeni porez smatra se konačnom poreznom obavezom
WHT shall be paid at the rate of 5% on dividend payments and 10% for interest, royalties, and other, if not reduced under a
Payment for performance of entertainment, art, or sports program in Republika Srpska.
The WHT rate in Republika Srpska is 10%.
The WHT rate in Brčko District is 10%.

figures.finding: VAT is a single state-level 17% with no reduced rate; registration is required above BAM 100,000 of taxable supplies.

sources.said: Any person making taxable supplies of goods and services that exceeds or is likely to exceed a threshold of 100,000 konvertibilna marka (convertible mark or BAM) is required to register as a VAT payer.
The standard VAT rate is 17%, and the VAT regime applies equally throughout the country of Bosnia and Herzegovina. There is no reduced VAT rate in Bosnia and Herzegovina.

figures.finding: In FBiH an artist, writer or other person earning author's fees deducts 30% of the fee as expenses (or actual expenses) before the 10% tax.
figures.applies: FBiH residents earning authors' fees; RS and BD rules not read (see the residents blocker).
